Why are black olives so much weaker than men?

Black olives aren’t inherently “weaker” than men—they’re food, while men are people, so it isn’t a meaningful comparison.

If you mean they seem softer or easier to crush than green olives: many black olives are fully ripe and/or cured in ways that make their flesh softer. Their texture depends on ripeness, olive variety, and processing method.
